authority.user_instruction: 批准 v06 方案，继续
authorized: Materialize, verify, freeze and inspect the v06 coarse/base/fine family
Close the pre-Stage-2 discretization block after a passing v06 inspection
Execute Stage 2 Gate A-E in strict order under its separate authorization
not_authorized: Modify v01-v05 frozen files or the Stage 1 v02 evidence
Change equations, mechanical parameters, contact potentials or load ledger
Add periodic geometry, turnover, nonzero j_myo or a parameter sweep
Publish a physiological or claim-bearing result

direct_inputs.role: immutable scientific mechanism and base contract
registered PreStage2 block and approved repair scope
user authorization for v06 and continued Stage 2 execution

scientific_object.name: early embryonic ventricular-wall local patch
excluded_claims: mature fibroblast or late cushion biology

nondimensionalization.A_H_rule: A_hat and H_ECM_hat are separate frozen variables; no density closure.

reference_geometry_and_state.deterministic_identity: Explicit icosahedron arrays, subdivision order, ECM tetra arrays, face subtypes and canonical serialization are frozen in the geometry spec.

cell_targets.V0: exact finalized oriented reference mesh volume
cell_targets.A0: exact reference area per persistent primary identity and directional subtype

material_tether_reference.physical_natural_gap: g0_pair is stored separately for every pair

force_free_conditions: cell targets equal exact reference values
every material tether has delta_g=0 and delta_t=0
the normal cohesive derivative is zero at delta_g=0
every dynamic steric source vertex is outside or on its target closed surface and reference steric energy is zero
the myocardial source map is complete while j_myo and every mapped source rate are zero
all fixed support references equal reference nodal positions
the assembled reference force and moment tests pass before any solver use
reference_geometry_and_state.reference_bundle_gate: All geometry, identity, tether including g0_pair, closed-surface steric reference checks, myocardial source-map, support, traction-free and gauge arrays must match their SHA-256 seal before implementation or response.

coordinate_and_load_convention.current_apical_outward_normal: n_a(x) from the current consistently oriented apical triangle
coordinate_and_load_convention.face_quadrature: One current-configuration barycenter point per oriented apical triangle with shape weights N_a=1/3.
coordinate_and_load_convention.current_face_area: A_f=0.5*||(x_1-x_0) cross (x_2-x_0)||; reference area is forbidden for blood-force assembly.
coordinate_and_load_convention.nodal_force_assembly: For face f and local node a, f_pressure_fa=(A_f/3)*t_p_f and f_WSS_fa=(A_f/3)*t_tau_f; global nodal forces are the sum of incident owned faces.
coordinate_and_load_convention.discrete_power: P_pressure=sum_i f_pressure_i dot v_i=sum_f A_f*t_p_f dot v_f; P_WSS uses the identical construction.
coordinate_and_load_convention.resultant_and_leakage: Compute resultants and forbidden components from the same assembled nodal force blocks used for power.
coordinate_and_load_convention.evaluation_state: Area, normal, projected traction and nodal velocity are evaluated at the same accepted or trial state used by the overdamped residual.

registered_time_protocols.combined_case_synchrony: activation, pressure and WSS use the same b(t) and zero delay
registered_time_protocols.zero_cases: Use the same gate duration with all registered inputs identically zero.

topology_and_material_identity.cell_representation: one independent watertight consistently oriented closed triangulated surface per cell
topology_and_material_identity.ECM_representation: independent structured six-tetra-per-brick volume mesh at the sealed coarse/base/fine intervals

primary_dynamics.numerical_gauge: Use only the exact global six-constraint zero-power gauge frozen in the geometry spec for otherwise unsupported cases.

active_preferred_length.anchor_weights: fixed normalized reference triangle-area barycentric nodal weights

dynamic_steric.pair_set: deterministic symmetric ordered source-vertex to complete closed target-surface search recomputed at every accepted state
dynamic_steric.target_surface: cell watertight boundary or ECM exterior boundary only; interior ECM tetra faces are forbidden
dynamic_steric.target_validity: the current target must be an embedded oriented closed 2-manifold without proper self-intersection; invalid cells fail and ECM also requires J>0
dynamic_steric.surface_owner: exactly one globally closest target face/edge/vertex feature per ordered source vertex and target entity
dynamic_steric.inside_outside: oriented generalized winding number of the complete target boundary with the frozen tolerances and failure rule in the geometry spec
dynamic_steric.physical_gap: g is positive global Euclidean distance outside, zero on the target boundary and negative global Euclidean distance inside
dynamic_steric.feature_switch_policy: piecewise derivative; feature or classification events are diagnostics and cannot silently satisfy a derivative test
dynamic_steric.edge_edge_policy: continuous triangle-triangle collision detection rejects any trial path with a proper unpenalized crossing; isolated tangency is allowed
dynamic_steric.reference_state: zero steric energy force moment and no proper intersections

material_adhesion.pair_set: the fully specified face-barycenter-to-fixed-slave-material-point registry from the reference geometry
material_adhesion.coverage: exactly one pair for every eligible master face
material_adhesion.compression_policy: Adhesion is tension-only: for delta_g<0 the normal cohesive force is zero. Because steric uses physical g, 0<=g<g0_pair is an intentional compression-slack interval and repulsion starts only for g<0.
material_adhesion.tangential_slip: [r dot t1-r0 dot t10, r dot t2-r0 dot t20]

contact_and_adhesion.complete_force: Every force is the complete negative nodal gradient of the selected discrete potential, including current normals, fixed material points and tangent-basis derivatives.

myocardial_source_map.owner: one record for every myocardial basal_ecm master-face barycenter quadrature
myocardial_source_map.geometry: reuse the IF_MYO_ECM material-tether ray hit as geometry only
myocardial_source_map.target: the unique ECM tetrahedron incident on the selected outer-facing boundary triangle
myocardial_source_map.reference_weight: exact reference area of the myocardial basal master triangle
myocardial_source_map.record_and_hash: source cell/face/barycentric, target ECM face/barycentric/tetra and reference weight are frozen and hashed
myocardial_source_map.assembly: all source amounts, ECM source residuals and source power are exactly zero in v04

full_patch.lateral_support: directional outward faces of perimeter myocardial cells according to grid index

boundary_contract.gate_C: myocardium.opposite_outer support; ECM lumen and lateral faces traction-free
boundary_contract.gate_D: fixed P_FIXTURE_D on ECM.outer_facing; all lateral faces traction-free
boundary_contract.periodic_rule: A future periodic-image/ECM-periodic specification requires a new geometry and case version.

flow_sensor.scope: one global diagnostic command-filter scalar in v04, not a per-cell or per-face biological sensor
flow_sensor.input_semantics: ||tau_w|| is the norm of the prescribed unprojected WSS command vector; it is not the norm of the projected local mechanical traction

verification_metric_definitions.static_equilibrium_residual: ||R||_2/max(1,sum of the 2-norms of all assembled conservative, dissipative and external nodal-force blocks)
verification_metric_definitions.blood_force_block_rule: pressure and WSS resultants leakage and powers are all computed from their respective common assembled nodal force block
verification_metric_definitions.time_refinement_relative_difference: |q_coarse-q_fine|/max(1e-8,|q_coarse|,|q_fine|); metrics whose registered exact-zero tolerance applies are checked by that absolute tolerance instead
verification_metric_definitions.time_quadrature: composite trapezoidal rule on accepted time nodes including both endpoints
verification_metric_definitions.moment_origin: reference patch origin; pair moment residual is origin invariant after the pair-force residual passes

time_refinement_observables: peak pressure and WSS resultants when enabled

spatial_refinement_policy.exact_zero_policy: Use the already registered absolute tolerance for exact-zero metrics.

review_finding_resolutions.V02-REF-TRACTION-001: Every material tether stores g0_pair and uses delta_g=g-g0_pair; assembled reference force/moment is a seal gate.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-GEOM-ID-001: Seed arrays, subdivision ID/output order and canonical array serialization are explicit.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-TETHER-SPEC-001: Quadrature, neighbor enumeration, ray hit, coverage, record fields, ownership and failure rules are explicit.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-BOUNDARY-MAP-001: Directional lateral subtypes and complete boundary owners are explicit; the invalid periodic sensitivity is removed.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-REFINEMENT-001: Spatial refinement is removed from v04 and required as a separate pre-Stage-2 geometry-family version.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-PROTOCOL-METRIC-001: Pressure/WSS envelopes, durations, synchrony, metric formulas and observables are frozen.
review_finding_resolutions.V02-SUPPORT-POWER-001: Only fixed support references are allowed; support and fixture base powers are identically zero.
review_finding_resolutions.V03-STERIC-SIGN-001: Steric gap is the signed global distance to a complete closed target boundary with one global feature owner; proper edge-edge crossings are rejected by deterministic collision detection.
review_finding_resolutions.V03-BLOOD-LOAD-DISCRETE-001: Current area, barycenter quadrature, one-third nodal weights, face velocity and common force-block power/resultant assembly are explicit.
review_finding_resolutions.V03-SOURCE-MAP-001: Every myocardial basal master face has one hashed source-map record to a unique boundary-adjacent ECM tetra while j_myo and assembly remain zero.
review_finding_resolutions.V03-ADH-COMPRESSION-SLACK-001: The interval 0<=g<g0_pair is explicitly registered as intentional tension-only adhesion slack before physical steric overlap.
review_finding_resolutions.V03-SENSOR-SEMANTICS-001: chi_E is explicitly limited to a global prescribed-command diagnostic with no local-shear or mechanical-feedback claim.
review_finding_resolutions.V05-FACE-TIE-001: Binary64 near-equal component comparisons use an 8*eps tie band and the fixed z-x-y priority, restoring mirror-consistent corner identities without changing topology, coordinates, mechanics or parameters.
review_finding_resolutions.V06-DISCRETIZATION-001: The separately approved coarse/base/fine identity-bearing family exists; base is byte-exact to v05 and response observables are preregistered.

completion_gate.next_required_action: v06 verification, freeze and read-only inspection; then Stage 2 Gate A

spatial_refinement_observables: peak pressure and WSS resultants when enabled
